title: Ball A speed
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be √(gL) or equivalent.

title: Ball B force magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 3mg or equivalent.

title: Condition at highest point
description: Important: Correctly applies the condition that the normal force on ball A is zero at the highest point to find its speed.

title: Angular velocity consistency
description: Important: Recognizes that both balls share the same angular velocity ω, and correctly relates it to the linear speeds v_A and v_B.

title: Force analysis for ball B
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law to ball B at the highest point, identifying all forces (gravity, rod force) and centripetal acceleration.

title: Newton's third law application
description: Optional: Explicitly states that the force of ball B on the rod is equal and opposite to the force of the rod on ball B.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the direction of the net force on ball B (e.g., setting F_B + mg = mω²(2L)) or misinterprets the force exerted by ball B on the rod as upward.

title: Radius confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect radius (e.g., L instead of 2L) for calculating the centripetal force on ball B.
